attractions.name: Larco Museum
attractions.description: One of South America's finest museums, housed inside an elegant 18th-century vice-royal mansion surrounded by vibrant gardens. Presents over 3,000 years of Peruvian history through ceramics, gold and silver treasures, textiles and archaeological masterpieces.

safety_tips.tip: Carry only the cash you'll need for the day and keep your passport, extra cash and valuables safely stored in your hotel's room safe whenever possible.
Store digital copies of your passport, visa, travel insurance and flight tickets on your phone or secure cloud storage.
Use only your pre-arranged private transfers or registered taxis arranged through your hotel. Avoid accepting rides from unofficial drivers at airports or tourist attractions.
Use ATMs located inside banks, shopping malls or reputable hotels. Notify your bank before travelling to avoid any issues with international card transactions.
Drink bottled or purified water throughout your trip. Avoid drinking tap water and ensure fruits are washed or peeled before consumption.
Tours and transportation operate on time, so it's best to arrive a few minutes early for all scheduled activities.

Many churches, monasteries and archaeological sites are considered sacred. Dress modestly when visiting religious sites, speak softly and avoid climbing or touching ancient Inca structures unless permitted.
Many locals in traditional Andean attire may expect a small tip for photographs. Always ask for permission before taking close-up photos.

connectivity_tips.tip: Claro Peru is one of Peru's largest mobile operators, offering excellent coverage across Lima, Cusco, the Sacred Valley and most tourist destinations. Best for overall coverage and high-speed data.
Movistar Peru is a reliable network with strong coverage in cities and good connectivity throughout much of the country. Best for travellers visiting multiple regions across Peru.
Entel Peru is known for fast 4G/5G speeds in urban areas and competitive prepaid data packages. Best for high-speed internet and short-term tourist plans.
Bitel is a budget-friendly provider offering affordable prepaid plans with generous data allowances. Best for cost-conscious travellers.

SIM cards are widely available at Jorge Chávez International Airport upon arrival, official Claro/Movistar/Entel/Bitel retail stores, and major supermarkets and convenience stores in Lima and Cusco. Original passport required for activation.
If your smartphone supports eSIM, you can activate a data plan before arriving in Peru. Popular providers include Airalo, Nomad and Holafly.

transport_options.description: Private vehicle with English-speaking guide for airport transfers and city tours. Approximately 45–60 minutes from Jorge Chávez International Airport to Miraflores (traffic dependent).

health_tips.tip: Ensure routine vaccinations are up to date before travelling, including Tetanus/Diphtheria/Pertussis (Td/Tdap), Measles/Mumps/Rubella (MMR), Polio and Influenza.
Hepatitis A vaccination is recommended for most travellers, as it can be transmitted through contaminated food or water.
Typhoid vaccination is recommended, especially if you plan to eat at local markets or travel beyond major cities.
Drink bottled or purified water throughout your trip. Avoid drinking tap water and ensure fruits are washed or peeled before consumption.
Carry personal medications with prescriptions if required, a small first-aid kit, motion sickness tablets if needed, hand sanitiser, wet wipes and anti-itch cream for insect bites.

Near Pullman Lima Miraflores: NaturLeben.Peru medical centre is approximately 1 minute walk (open Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–6:30 PM, Sat 9:00 AM–4:30 PM, closed Sun). Boticas Perú pharmacy is approximately 3 minutes walk (open 7:00 AM–10:30 PM).
